title_en: Interim Measures for the Administration of Cable Television

articles.content_en: Article 1 These Measures are formulated for the purpose of strengthening the administration of cable television, publicizing the laws and policies of the State, disseminating scientific and cultural knowledge, enriching the spiritual life of the people, and promoting the construction of socialist material civilization and socialist spiritual civilization.

Article 3 The administrative department of radio and television under the State Council shall be responsible for the administration of cable television nationwide and the development planning of cable television undertakings.
The administrative departments of radio and television of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government shall be responsible for the administration of cable television and the development planning of cable television undertakings within their respective administrative regions.

Article 5 Any unit or individual that installs a shared antenna system must improve management measures or assign management personnel, and must use transmission equipment certified as conforming to the relevant national technical standards by the administrative department of radio and television at or above the provincial level.
It is prohibited to use a shared antenna system to broadcast self-produced television programs or video tapes.

Article 6 To establish a cable television station, the matter must be preliminarily examined and approved by the administrative department of radio and television at the provincial level, and then be submitted to the administrative department of radio and television under the State Council for approval, and the License for Cable Television Station shall be issued by the administrative department of radio and television under the State Council.
To establish a cable television station, the matter must be preliminarily examined and approved by the administrative department of radio and television at the county level, and then be submitted to the administrative department of radio and television at the provincial level for approval, and the License for Cable Television Station shall be issued by the administrative department of radio and television at the provincial level.
For the installation of a shared antenna system, the unit or individual installing the shared antenna system shall file it with the administrative department of radio and television at the county level for record.

Article 7 Where an engineering design or installation unit undertakes the engineering design or installation tasks of a cable television station, it must obtain approval from the administrative department of radio and television at the provincial level, and the Design (Installation) License for Cable Television Station shall be issued by the administrative department of radio and television at the provincial level.
Where an engineering design or installation unit undertakes the design or installation tasks of a cable television station or a shared antenna system, it must obtain approval from the administrative department of radio and television at the county level, and the Design (Installation) License for Cable Television Station and Shared Antenna System shall be issued by the administrative department of radio and television at the county level.

Article 8 After the completion of the construction of a cable television station, the administrative department of radio and television at the provincial level shall organize or entrust relevant units to carry out acceptance inspection. Where no acceptance inspection has been conducted or the acceptance inspection is not passed, the cable television station shall not be put into use.

Article 9 The television programs broadcast by a cable television station must comply with the relevant laws and regulations and the provisions of the relevant State departments on television programs and video products. It is strictly prohibited to broadcast self-produced television programs or video tapes that are reactionary, obscene, or detrimental to national security and social stability.
Article 10 A cable television station must directly receive and transmit the news and other important programs of China Central Television and local television stations in their entirety.

Article 11 The unit that establishes a cable television station shall establish and improve management systems for equipment, program lists, broadcasting, etc., and must compile a monthly schedule of broadcast programs, which, after being examined and verified by the leading official in charge of the establishing unit, shall be submitted to the administrative department of radio and television at the county level for record.

Article 12 Where an established cable television station that, due to changes in conditions, ceases to operate, shall report to the approving authority within one month, and the approving authority shall cancel the license.

Article 13 Cable television stations for administrative regions shall be established by the local administrative department of radio and television in accordance with the relevant provisions of the administrative department of radio and television under the State Council.

Article 14 The establishment of cable television for educational purposes by a school shall be subject to examination, approval, and administration by the relevant education administrative department by reference to the provisions of these Measures, and the approving authority shall send a copy of the approval document to the administrative department of radio and television at or above the county level where the school is located for record.

Article 16 If a party does not accept the administrative penalty decision of the administrative department of radio and television, it may, within 15 days from the date of receipt of the written decision on the penalty, apply for reconsideration to the authority at the next higher level that made the administrative penalty decision. The administrative department of radio and television at the next higher level shall make a reconsideration decision within one month from the date of receipt of the reconsideration application. If the party does not accept the reconsideration decision, it may, within 15 days from the date of receipt of the reconsideration decision, bring a lawsuit to the People's Court. If the party, within the prescribed time limit, neither applies for reconsideration nor brings a lawsuit to the People's Court nor performs the penalty decision, the authority that made the penalty decision shall apply to the People's Court for compulsory execution.

Article 17 For any act that violates these Measures and constitutes an act against public security administration, the public security organ shall impose penalties in accordance with the provisions of the Law of the People's Republic of China on Penalties for Administration of Public Security; if the circumstances are serious and constitute a crime, the judicial organ shall investigate criminal liability according to law.

Article 18 Cable television systems used for national defense, public security, and national security services shall be managed respectively by the relevant departments of the Chinese People's Liberation Army, the Ministry of Public Security, and the Ministry of State Security.
Article 19 The administrative department of radio and television under the State Council shall be responsible for the interpretation of these Measures.
Article 20 These Measures shall come into force as of the date of promulgation.
